caption_L1: Here a line graph is called Year-on-year change of weekly flight frequency of global airlines from January 6 to December 22 , 2020 , by country. On the x-axis, Week starting on is defined with a categorical scale starting at April and ending at October. United Arab Emirates is defined on a categorical scale from −0.8 to 0.0 along the y-axis.
caption_L2L3: Flight frequency seemed to drop drastically from the beginning to April, however, I am unsure how much a drop of -0.8 truly is - perhaps the scale being fixed to the data range doesn't help project the true message overall?Since April, there is a gradual increase in the flight frequency, which doesn't seem necessarily to be associated with seasonal periods where people typically take flights, such as over summer.
